info.title: Family Assistant API
info.description: Mutating requests must send `X-FA-Request: 1`. Errors are `application/problem+json`.

401.description: wrong password; counts toward the login lockout

204.description: the key backup is recorded as confirmed

200.description: stored; the server applies the change by restarting its services

409.description: code `setting_locked`: an environment variable sets the key

post.summary:
Limits (422 `{field}` beyond them): `title` 200 characters, `notes` 10 000, at most 50
`steps_template` entries of 200 characters each.

get.summary:
Tasks, newest created first: keyset on `created_at DESC, id DESC`, cursor `created_at`.
`view=now` is a short ranked list and is not paged. `suggested` tasks (made from mail) are
returned only to a signed-in adult; for a child or a device (elevated or not) they are left
out, so `status=suggested` is empty.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: RFC 3339 cursor: the `next_before` of the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, default 50, at most 200 (above is clamped).

post.summary:
Creates a task. Limits (422 `{field}` beyond them): `title` 200 characters, `notes` 10 000,
at most 50 `steps` of 200 characters each. Every assignee must be an active member of the
household; a child can assign only themself.

patch.summary:
Edits a task (`If-Match` required). Same limits as creating: `title` 200 characters, `notes`
10 000, at most 50 `steps` of 200 characters. Newly added assignees must be active members of
the household; a child may set `assignees` to empty or to themself only (403 otherwise).

409.description: claimed by someone else or not open

422.description: not a pool task or not a candidate

built_at.description: RFC 3339 time the server binary was built, when known.

commit.description: Short git commit the server was built from; `None` when the build had no git data.

AiPipelinePoint.description: The `llm` stage of one email decision point.

llm_stage_present.description:
Whether the active version has an `llm` stage at all. In `llm_first` a point without one is
still asked, so the UI shows it as on unless a stage exists and is switched off (D-107).

rules_threshold.description:
The `rules` stage's confidence bar (`rules_first`: below it the LLM is asked). 0.5 to 0.99,
default 0.8.
0.5 to 0.99; absent keeps the stored one. A change is a new pipeline version.

catchup_days.description: Only messages received within this many days are caught up (0 to 365).

event_dedupe_llm.description: Ask the LLM whether a proposed event is already on the calendar (default on).

event_dedupe_threshold.description: A "duplicate" answer at or above this confidence drops the proposal (0 to 1, default 0.8).

extract_fallback_cutoff.description:
`rules_first` and `mail_extract_mode = fallback`: the LLM extracts when no rule extractor
reached this confidence (0.5 to 0.99).

catchup_days.description: 0 to 365; 0 switches the catch-up off. Absent keeps the stored value (default 30).

event_dedupe_llm.description: Check proposed events against the calendar with the LLM. Absent keeps the stored value.

event_dedupe_threshold.description: 0 to 1. Absent keeps the stored value (default 0.8).

extract_fallback_cutoff.description: 0.5 to 0.99. Absent keeps the stored value (default 0.8).

BillPage.description: One page of `GET /bills`, newest created first.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

BillPatchStatus.description: The statuses a user may set on a bill.

BillTemplate.description: Per-organisation bill regexes (capture group 1 is the value).

CalendarViewExt.description: A calendar plus whether it is a default target for extracted events.

CategoryPatch.description: The key is immutable. Archive with `archived: true`.

gender.description: Optional; used only for mail relevance (D-055).

DarkTheme.description: The night-time family and variant of a [`ThemeChoice`].

completion_override.description: Anyone may complete tasks from the dashboard (D-013).

week_start.description: First day of the week (`monday` or `sunday`).

DashboardMeal.description: One planned meal on the dashboard; `time` is local `"HH:MM"`.

confetti.description: Confetti when a routine run is completed on this device.

food_view.description: Shows the Food view (meal plan and shopping list) on this device (D-117).

screensaver_minutes.description: Minutes without a touch before the screensaver starts; 0 turns it off.

snow.description: Falling snow behind the cards on this device.

meals.description: Today's visible meal slots with their planned entries; empty when nothing is planned.

pending_approvals.description: Pending approvals per adult; empty when the household setting is off.

task_lists.description: Active task lists (the add form offers those with `dashboard_add`).

DecisionPointKey.description: The five decision points. `as_str` and the wire format are the dotted key.

DiscardedCount.description: How many items a bulk inbox action changed.

pending_cancel.description: The proposal is to delete an event we wrote (a cancellation arrived).

merged.description: True when several calendars' copies of the same event were folded into this one.

auto_write.description: Write approved-by-rule events without asking (default off, D-057).

extract_threshold.description: Extraction confidence needed for auto write, 0..1.

route_threshold.description: Routing confidence needed for auto write, 0..1.

ExtractOrigin.description: Who produced an extracted event, bill or task.

FailedJob.description:
One failed (`dead`) or retrying (`queued`, already attempted) background job. Payloads are
never included; `refs` holds only id-like payload keys (for example `message_id`).

run_at.description: RFC 3339; next attempt for a retrying job.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339; when the last failure was recorded.

GenderTerms.description: Words in mail that point at a gender-specific group ("girls' soccer").

GroceryAddReq.description: `id` may be client-generated so a replayed offline add is idempotent (D-118).

GroceryImpact.description: A generated grocery item that a plan change touches.

GroceryItemView.description: `display` is the quantity text in household units, e.g. `"2 ½ cups"`, `"750 g"`, `"3"`.

bill_lead_days.description: Days before a bill's due date that its pay task is due (0..=60).

dashboard_completion_override.description: Adults may let dashboards (devices) tick off tasks.

google_oauth_enabled.description: Read-only: true when the Google client is configured.

dashboard_pending_approvals.description: Dashboards show how many approvals wait for each adult.

Hue.description: One of eight named hues; each theme supplies its own shade (wire: lowercase name).

ImapSettings.description: IMAP connection settings. Debug output omits the password.

password.description: Write-only; stored as a secret. Absent on a patch = keep.

InboxPage.description: One page of `GET /inbox`, newest first. `counts` cover every kind and every page.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

IngredientProposal.description: An LLM proposal for an unmatched line. An adult accepts it or picks another match.

JobErrorGroup.description: Failed or retrying jobs of one kind with the same first error line.

error.description: First line of the stored error.

last_at.description: RFC 3339; most recent failure in the group.

retrying.description: Queued jobs of this household that failed before and will be retried.

LineMatchReq.description: Pick an existing ingredient, or create `new_name` (in `aisle_id`).

awaiting.description: Processed by the rules only, waiting for the LLM to come back.

queued.description: A `mail.llm` job is queued or running.

catchup.description: A catch-up was queued: messages that were `awaiting` are queued again.

released.description: Queued `mail.llm` jobs made runnable now (their retry wait was skipped).

LlmEndpointPut.description:
Body of `PUT /ai/llm-endpoint`. `api_key`: absent keeps the stored key, `null` clears it, a
string sets it.

thinking.description: Let a thinking model reason before it answers. Absent: off.

LlmEndpointTest.description: Body of `POST /ai/llm-endpoint/test`: unsaved values; a missing field uses the stored one.

api_key.description: Absent: the stored key. `null`: no key. A string: that key.

LlmProblem.description: The AI provider's most recent failed call and recent health (last 24 hours).

must_change_password.description:
True while the password was set by another adult; the client sends the user to the
Account page to choose their own.

undo_until.description: RFC 3339; undo is refused after this instant (30 days, D-058).

MailMode.description:
Who goes first: the LLM (the rules apply at once as a provisional value and as the
fallback), the rules (the LLM is asked only when they are unsure), or the LLM alone (no
rule decides or extracts; without an endpoint the message waits). D-107.

oneOf.description: Only `paused` and `ok` are accepted: pause or resume.

can_manage.description: The viewer may edit, pause or remove the source.

key_base64.description: Standard base64 of the 32 raw key bytes.

must_change_password.description: True while the signed-in account still has the password another adult set.

MealPlanEntryInput.description: Either `recipe_id` or `free_text`. The entry is appended to the slot.

MealPlanEntryView.description: `date` is `YYYY-MM-DD`. `title` is the recipe title, or the free text.

MealSlotView.description: `time` is local `"HH:MM"`. `id` absent on a new slot in `PUT /meals/slots`.

MealsSettingsPatch.description: Every field optional; absent keeps the stored value.

MemberDto.description: Full member view for adults. Never includes the PIN hash.

initial_password.description: True while the login's password was set by another adult (an adult not yet claimed).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version for `If-Match` (0 when not loaded).

MemberPublicDto.description: Public fields, visible to children and devices.

avatar_url.description: `/api/v1/members/{id}/avatar?v=<sha256 prefix>`; set by the API layer.

MemberSelection.description: `"all"` or a list of member IDs.

MemberView.description: Either member view, as returned by the members API (untagged).

can_act.description: The viewer may apply mail actions (writable source, `GmailAction`).

content_purged.description: The body was purged by the retention policy.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page.

external_url.description: Computed link back to the original message (Gmail only).

address.description: Defaults to the OAuth account's email (Gmail) or the IMAP username.

NewSource.description: New source. Debug output redacts passwords and URLs.

oneOf.description: The acting member on a dashboard device.

quiet_from.description: Absent = keep, `null` = use the household default.

server_configured.description: False when the server has no `FA_NTFY_URL`.

topic.description: Shown only to that member and to adults.

NowWeights.description: Weights of the Now score (D-042), stored in `household.now_weights`.

OrgPage.description: One page of `GET /orgs`, newest created first.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

lan_pair_url.description: The same link on the home-network dashboard address, when that is on (D-064).

Panel.description: A panel with a kind and kind-specific options. Unknown kinds and options are kept as they are.

PasswordBody.description:
An adult resetting a child's password sends `PasswordReq`; a member changing their own sends
`OwnPasswordChange` (C-03).

Problem.description: The `application/problem+json` body (RFC 9457). Invalid weather rules add `position` and `message`.

code.description:
Machine-readable code of the setup and system routes (`setup_required`, `setup_closed`,
`setting_locked`, `invalid_setting`).

field.description: Task and routine validation errors: the offending input field.

position.description: Weather-rule errors only: char offset into the condition.

stars.description: 1 to 5, or null to remove the rating.

RecipeDraft.description: A recipe extracted from a page. Minutes are integers; `source_url` is an absolute URL.

RecipeInput.description: Create and update body. `lines` are the raw ingredient lines; `steps` are the step texts.

no_school_match.description: Defaults to `no school, holiday, inset, closed`.

RuleCondition.description: `{field, op, header?, values}`; `header` names the header when `field = header`.

Season.description: A season window, both ends `"MM-DD"`; may wrap the year end.

SessionPage.description: One page of `GET /sessions`, newest created first.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

id.description: One-way handle, not the cookie value.

owner_needed.description: A household exists but no adult account.

via_tailscale.description: Secure and the host ends in `.ts.net`.

SourceCredentials.description: Replacement credentials; any subset. Debug output is redacted.

SourceHint.description: One place an item came from, for the "for Tue dinner" hint.

writable.description: Google sources need the account to have granted calendar write access (else 422).

masked_url.description: `https://host/…`; the full URL is a secret and never returned.

writable.description: Extracted events may be written to this source's calendars.

SourceViewExt.description: A calendar source plus whether the app may write events to it.

StoreAisleView.description: One aisle in a store's own order (D-121).

SwapReq.description: Swap `a` with `b`, or move `a` into the (empty) slot `date` + `slot_id`.

values.description: `null` resets a key to the default; a secret takes a string.

oneOf.description: Who the next occurrence goes to (rotation and fixed).

TaskListInput.description: Every field is explicit; the UI fills it from `list_defaults(kind)`.

claim_ttl_minutes.description: Absent = keep, `null` = end of the local day.

TaskPage.description: One page of `GET /tasks`, newest created first. `view=now` is never paged.

next_before.description: RFC 3339; pass as `before` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

steps.description: Replacing the steps keeps ticks for unchanged texts.

assignee_away.description: A fixed assignee is away on the due date.

undo_until.description: Until when a reopen restores the definition.

TemplateApplyReq.description: Slots in `add_slots` keep their entries and get the items appended; every other target slot is replaced.

TemplateFromPlanReq.description: Save a template from a plan range; `from` and `to` are `YYYY-MM-DD`, at most 366 days.

ThemeChoice.description: A device's theme. Reads the legacy string form; always writes the object.

oneOf.description: Theme used when the effective mode is dark; `None` keeps the daytime family.

Visibility.description: D-036: `Busy` hides title, location and description.

WeekStart.description: First day of the week on calendars; default Monday.
